title: IBM Quantum Backend
description: Schema for an IBM Quantum backend (QPU or simulator) as returned by the Qiskit Runtime REST API endpoint GET /v1/backends/{id}/configuration. Reflects the OpenQASM-based backend configuration model.

n_qubits.description: Number of qubits exposed by the backend.

basis_gates.description: Native gates supported by the backend (e.g. cz, sx, x, rz, id, ecr).

coupling_map.description: Connectivity graph as a list of [control, target] qubit-index pairs.

simulator.description: True if the backend is a classical simulator.

operational.description: True if the backend is currently online.

pending_jobs.description: Approximate length of the backend queue.

processor_type.description: Processor family metadata, e.g. Heron, Eagle, Condor.

max_shots.description: Maximum number of shots accepted per circuit.

max_experiments.description: Maximum number of circuits accepted per primitive call.

open_pulse.description: Whether OpenPulse is supported on this backend.

supported_instructions.description: All instructions accepted by the backend.

credits_required.description: Whether the backend requires plan credits.
